title: Full Metal Daemon Muramasa: The Two Wheels
alt: A night sky high over a sea of clouds, with a huge pale moon at the left and the last red of the day behind a wide dark mountain at the right. Near us a suit of crimson armour flies to the left. It has tall golden horns on its helmet, a shoulder guard of dark plates with gold studs, a red thruster with a fan of red blades and fire on its back, and a long sword held low with blue lightning on it. A trail of fire curves away behind it. Far off, near the moon, a silver light with a long white trail comes toward it.
summary: A painting of a duel in the sky from Full Metal Daemon Muramasa in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is a duel in the sky from Full Metal Daemon Muramasa, a visual novel by Nitroplus. In it the armour of a warrior is a living thing of steel, a tsurugi, and it flies. Two of them fight as two wheels that touch: each goes round its own circle, and where the circles touch, they strike.
The crimson armour is Muramasa, and Kageaki Minato wears it. The silver light far off is the Silver Star, which he hunts. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
